predecessor.adversary: A pending native write is prematurely acknowledged by an invalid clock reason before refusal; expected acknowledgement 0, observed 1.

correctedAdversary.assertions: For every denied callback with one pending native write: no journal drain or acknowledgement, no board RAM or page-generation mutation, no N/Q mutation. A later valid transfer reconciles the write once.

scope: Local actual free BIOS cold guest; the correction preflights malformed clock tapes, page/scalar arguments, reentry and forbidden PIC ACK before native journal acknowledgement. Stateful board PIO errors after valid argument admission remain outside this denial assertion. CPU3 memory callbacks still cross JavaScript; no measured speed improvement, new clock authority or wider PC qualification is claimed.
